workflow.display-name: CB - Crypto - Benchmark ES5 vs Node
workflow.description: Times SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256 and AES encrypt/decrypt with the pure ES5 module (in.co.cloudblogger.crypto) and the Node.js module (in.co.cloudblogger.crypto.node) on a generated payload. Prints a comparison table of median times to the run log and returns all timings as Properties. Uses a random AES key and HMAC key per run; ES5 AES is CBC, Node.js AES is GCM. The Node.js actions run as action elements, so each call shows on the canvas; Node.js times include the start of the polyglot runtime for every call.

param.name: payloadSizeBytes
param.description: Size of the generated test payload in bytes (1 to 1048576). The blog uses 100, 10240 and 102400.

param.name: es5Repetitions
param.description: How many times each ES5 operation runs (1 to 100). The median is reported.

param.name: includeNode
param.description: Also time the Node.js actions. Each Node.js call takes about 2 seconds, and the first call after the runtime has been idle can take much longer.

param.name: nodeRepetitions
param.description: How many times each Node.js operation runs (1 to 20), after one separate first call.

param.name: results
param.description: All timings in milliseconds (es5.<op>.medianMs/minMs/maxMs, node.<op>.medianMs/minMs/maxMs, node.firstCallMs) plus payloadSizeBytes and digestsMatch.

param.name: summary
param.description: The comparison table as plain text, as printed in the run log.
